subject: Renewal + expansion pricing: volume step-ups, blended rates, adding new routes/models
messages:
From: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@stellarretail.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning: pricing, volumes, new routes/models

Marissa —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. As discussed, we are entering renewal conversations for our platform usage and expect to expand into a few new inference routes (personalization + product copy + category tagging). Quick background: current baseline is ~15M tokens/month on the existing routes. We expect an incremental 20-30M tokens/month once the new routes are fully rolled out (~3-6 months post-launch).

Key asks for our procurement/finance team so we can evaluate options:
- Do you have target unit-economics guidance (target $/1M tokens) for committed volumes?
- Can you model blended rates for a renewal that includes step-ups (monthly ramp to 50M+ tokens)?
- What flexibility do you offer around routes/models (e.g., different unit prices for new model types vs. standard routes)?

We're aiming to land something within our renewal budget range - rough ballpark for the renewal + expansion is $300k-$450k ARR, but we need concrete per-1M pricing to validate.

Alex Moreno (cc'd) will be the procurement lead. Can you send a short recap and a couple of pricing scenarios? We'd like a draft quote to share with finance this week if possible.

Thanks,
Jennifer
VP Product, Stellar Retail
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-29T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: pricing, volumes, new routes/models

Jennifer —

Great to sync - appreciate the clear context. Below is a short post-call recap and a few qualification items so we can model accurate scenarios for finance.

Recap (you can correct me if I missed anything):
- Current: ~15M tokens/mo across existing routes
- Target expansion: +20-30M tokens/mo after rollout (expected full rollout ~3-6 months)
- Procurement contact: Alex Moreno (cc)
- Target renewal budget: ~$300k- $450k ARR (approx)

Qualification / follow-ups I need to model pricing:
1) Volume timeline: can you confirm a preferred ramp (example): months 1-3: 15M, months 4-6: 30M, months 7-12: 50M? If you have a different ramp, send it over.
2) Target $/1M tokens: you mentioned wanting unit economics - is your target ~$700- $900 per 1M tokens (we use that band as a starting point in other retail accounts)?
3) Mix of routes/models: will the new routes use the same model family or heavier models (higher compute per token)? If heavier, we'll show model-differentiated routing and blended pricing.
4) Commitment term: are you looking at 12-month renewal with committed monthly minimums, or prefer a quarterly ramp? Committed minimums materially affect blended unit price.

Attached is a simple pricing model (pricing_model_v3.xlsx) - I filled in a conservative step-up example and two blended-rate options (committed vs. on-demand). If you can confirm the ramp and the target $/1M range, I'll run the formal quote and share a draft renewal quote + SOW for procurement.

Next steps:
- Can we confirm a short call with Alex + finance on April 6 to review the draft?
- I'll get a draft quote to you by April 1 assuming the ramp above.

Thanks - I'll take your answers into the model and circle back.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing_model_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@stellarretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@stellarretail.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: pricing, volumes, new routes/models

Marissa —

Thanks - confirmed on most of this. Here’s a clearer ramp and budget guidance from finance:
- Ramp (we expect): months 1-3: 15M/mo; months 4-6: 25-30M/mo; months 7-12: 45-55M/mo (50M is a good planning number)
- Mix: two of the new routes use a slightly heavier model (~1.3x compute/token vs. our current routes). The third route is roughly equivalent to current compute.
- Budget target: renewal + expansion target ~$350k ARR (we can go up to $450k if unit economics are favorable)
- Target unit economics: finance would like to see base blended at ~$800/1M tokens (give-or-take). If you can show tiered blended pricing that reaches ~$700/1M at scale (>50M), that would be ideal.

Procurement note: Alex will need a draft SOW + quote to start PO / purchase order routing. I attached a small traffic projection export to help with exact monthly numbers.

Would appreciate two scenarios in the draft quote: (A) 12-month committed with monthly minimums and step-up discounts, (B) 12-month with higher on-demand pricing but no minimums.

Thanks - we’re motivated to move quickly on this.

- Jennifer
[Attachment: traffic_projection_q2.csv (spreadsheet export)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@stellarretail.com>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: pricing, volumes, new routes/models - draft pricing summary

Jennifer / Alex —

Appreciate the clarity - I ran the scenarios and put together a short draft pricing summary. This is a high-level starting point (finance will need the formal quote + SOW), but it should align with the budget and target unit economics you described.

High-level proposed blended pricing (committed, 12-month renewal with monthly minimums):
- 0-20M tokens/mo: $1,100 per 1M tokens
- 20-50M tokens/mo: $900 per 1M tokens
- >50M tokens/mo: $700 per 1M tokens

Notes:
- Given two routes are ~1.3x compute, we’ll apply a model-differentiated multiplier in the formal quote; the blended numbers above assume weighted mix from your traffic projection.
- If you commit to a stepped monthly minimum (example ramp in your projection), the blended avg for months 7-12 lands near ~$725- $750/1M in our model (depending on exact mix), which is within your target band.
- Option B (no minimums / higher on-demand): add a ~20% premium to each tier (I’ll include exact numbers in the quote).

Next steps from our side:
1) I’ll generate a formal renewal quote + draft SOW and send to Alex & finance by EOD April 3.
2) We’ll include two scenarios (committed step-up vs. on-demand) and explicit blended calculations tied to your traffic CSV.
3) Schedule: happy to join the April 6 call with finance/procurement to walk through the SOW and contract cadence.

Attached: draft_renewal_quote_v1.pdf (placeholder high-level numbers). Let me know if you want me to tighten any of the assumptions before I push to legal/finance.

Thanks - looking forward to closing this in the next few weeks.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
[Attachment: draft_renewal_quote_v1.pdf (pdf)]
